The longest time without a record that
still belongs to the same tour. With more
in between (a picnic, a drive), a new
The next record must be close enough
to reach in the time between them:
The base distance allows for birds
often being recorded some way off.
A record's coordinates often show where
the bird was, not where you stood. So a
tour's records are cut into time windows;
each becomes one point in their middle
(where your phone's GPS is known, only
○ record (bird's position) ● middle of the time window
Where time windows in a row lie this
close together, you stayed a while: they
make one stop. The stops are the tour's
points on the map, their number is in the
"Stops" column, the length is the line
Minimum length (1 km) and minimum duration (60 min)
Shorter tours are not shown, e.g. a
short stop at the edge of a field.
